semantics.requires_all: all listed capability evidence is required
semantics.requires_any: for each inner list at least one listed capability is required
semantics.may_produce: candidate output names only; successful process exit or terminal state does not grant them
semantics.actions: each action must satisfy both node and own requirements and independent acceptance; missing sibling output does not block
semantics.optional_purpose_error: R9-22 is consumed only by the specific response/law needing it; not a universal dependency
semantics.capability_binding: A token is usable only with current statement/source/method/input evidence and eligibility; prototype or process exit never grants production capability. Every consumer must use one coherent candidate binding.
semantics.conditional_requirements: Additional all-of requirements apply if the explicitly named method selector is true. Unselected selectors must be recorded false; unknown is not false.
semantics.alternative_producers: Multiple producers of CMB_RESPONSE are alternative method-bound implementations, not independent measurements; never combine their capabilities across candidate IDs.
